purpose: Teach: 位相/流体/研磨/僻地/共振/界面/発振/電極

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、心臓の位相心電図を医療チームで解析します
lines.en: Ren, we analyze the cardiac phase ECG with the medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured opening. Direct eye contact. Clinical but not cold. Slight pause after his name — establishing both professionalism and recognition.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、点滴の流体力学を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Yes, we utilize the IV fluid dynamics across the medical team.
lines.style: Steady, continuing. No rush. Voice sits at the same level as before — this is routine procedure, delivered with quiet assurance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人工関節の研磨技術を医療チームで採用します
lines.en: Ren, we're adopting the prosthetic joint polishing technique with the medical team.
lines.style: Same clinical composure. Slight emphasis on 'adopting' — indicating forward movement, investment in new methods. Still measured.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 僻地医療巡回を、貴院、推進されてますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does prioritize rural medical outreach, doesn't it, doctor?
lines.style: Soft, genuine curiosity underneath. Slight hesitation before speaking — respect for her position. Not quite a question, more of a wondering observation. Ends gently upward.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、声帯の共振解析を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Yes, we conduct vocal resonance analysis with the medical team.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Clinical rhythm established. Breathing steady. No deviation from the professional register — this is part of the same explanation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療現場の界面消毒を医療チームで徹底します
lines.en: Yes, the medical team maintains strict surface disinfection protocols in the clinical setting.
lines.style: Slight weight on 'strict' — not aggressive, but conveying that this is non-negotiable. Voice steady, competent. The clarity of someone who takes these details seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 心臓の発振リズム異常を、貴院、診られますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital diagnoses cardiac arrhythmia cases well, doesn't it, doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, probing gently. Quiet respect in the register. Second observation — testing understanding, not challenging. Soft trailing on the final honorific.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、心電図電極の管理を医療チームで日々おこないます
lines.en: Yes, the medical team handles ECG electrode management on a daily basis.
lines.style: Close, almost intimate in its professionalism. Quieter than before — drawing Ren in. Still clinical, but the proximity suggests shared understanding. Breath audible at the edges.
